items.title: Is Freeport McMoRan (FCX) About To Transform U.S. Copper Supply With $4.5 Billion?
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE:FCX) approved a US$4.5b expansion at its Bagdad copper and molybdenum mine in Arizona. The Bagdad project is expected to more than double current output once the enlarged operation is fully up and running. The buildout includes deployment of autonomous mining fleets aimed at improving operating efficiency and unit costs across the site. items.title: Freeport's $4.5 Billion Bagdad Expansion to Boost U.S. Production
items.summary: FCX's $4.5B Bagdad expansion aims to more than double mining and milling rates, boost copper and molybdenum output, and cut long-term unit costs by 20%.
